author: The Infographics Show
description:
Nazi Germany claimed that Jewish ancestry made someone unfit to belong to the German nation. Yet thousands of men the regime itself classified as having partial Jewish ancestry served in the Wehrmacht, with some becoming highly decorated officers and war heroes.

This video explores one of the strangest contradictions inside Hitler’s racial system. Werner Goldberg, a part-Jewish soldier, was even used in propaganda as the “ideal German soldier” before authorities discovered his ancestry. Other high-ranking officers received special exemptions, and Hitler personally approved declarations allowing certain men of Jewish descent to remain in service. For many ordinary soldiers, military service offered no such protection. Some fought for Germany while their relatives were stripped of their rights, deported, imprisoned, or murdered. As the war continued, exemptions disappeared and thousands of these men were removed from the military and sent into forced labor.
